name: Raster Music Tracker module
note: RMT is the Atari 8-bit POKEY tracker, and its modules turn up embedded in
7800 cartridges: 84 images across 41 titles in the library carry one.
This describes how to FIND and READ one, not how to play it. A module
carries its own magic -- "RMT" then '4' or '8' for the channel count --
so it is matched on that rather than on a player fingerprint. That matters:
the same module format sits behind several different player builds, and
keying on the player would split one format across several descriptions
and miss games that embed a module with no recognisable player at all.
Rendering is deliberately not attempted. RMT's sound comes from its
instrument engine -- per-instrument envelope tables for volume, distortion
and pitch, plus effects -- so the note list alone is not the tune. Getting
it right means reimplementing the replayer; getting it wrong means a song
that looks right and plays wrong. Record one with tracker.py capture.
